parameters.name: DeadEndDate
parameters.description: The end of the expiration date range to query.

parameters.name: DeadStartDate
parameters.description: The start of the expiration date range to query.

parameters.name: DomainType
parameters.description:
The domain name type. Valid values:

GUOJI
TONGYONG
GUONEI
NAME
WEIBO.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end of the expiration date range to query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the error message returned by the operation. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English.

parameters.name: OrderByType
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order
DESC: descending order.

parameters.name: OrderKeyType
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort the domain name list. Valid values:

REGDATE: registration date
DEADDATE: expiration date
CREATEDATE: creation date.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ProductDomainType
parameters.description:
The domain name product type. Valid values:

New gTLD
gTLD
ccTLD
other.

parameters.name: QueryType
parameters.description:
The query type. Valid values:

1: renewal
2: redeem
4: transfer-out.

parameters.name: RegEndDate
parameters.description: The end of the registration date range to query.

parameters.name: RegStartDate
parameters.description: The start of the registration date range to query.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start of the expiration date range to query.

parameters.name: UserClientIp
parameters.description: The user IP address. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1.
